Star Map Temple
Great wheels from a forgotten time 
thunder and clank in the jungle!
The verdant jungle has almost 
consumed the white marble pillars and 
walls of this ancient temple. Mighty 
wheels still turn heavily inside its 
grounds, shaking the earth with each 
rotation. What forgotten dooms, and 
portents do these wheels predict? 
RANDOM ENCOUNTERS
d4
Details
1
A dial turns, rumbling the 
earth; DC 12 DEX or fall down
2
Maied (Area 2) wanders in to 
tend the vines and flowers 
3
A hungry panther from Area 7 
stalks the group
4
Three roving Itzalca warriors 
(soldiers) creep into the temple
Cosmic Wheels. Each weighs several 
tons and carries an enchantment that 
keeps it untarnished; removing it from 
its spindle converts it to useless stone.
